meta.title: Stack emission & water norms for coal/lignite (and gas) thermal power plants, India
meta.primary: MoEFCC S.O. 3305(E) dated 07-12-2015, Environment (Protection) Amendment Rules, 2015 (Schedule I, entry 25 Thermal Power Plant)
meta.units: mg/Nm3 at 6% O2 dry (coal/lignite stack norms); gas turbine NOx in ppm(v/v) at 15% O2
meta.how_to_apply: Pick vintage by unit commissioning date (CO2 baseline DB / CEA FGD list give dates); SO2 & Hg depend on unit size (<500 MW vs >=500 MW) for pre-2017 units. SO2 applicability after 11-Jul-2025 also depends on category (see fgd_units.json): Category C units are exempt from the SO2 limit (stack height only).
meta.licence: Government of India publications; reuse with attribution

coal_lignite_units.compliance: within 2 years of notification (by 2017-12-07), later category-wise deadlines for SO2 (see fgd_units.json)

coal_lignite_units.nox_note: 300 mg/Nm3 in 2015 notification; relaxed to 450 by G.S.R. 662(E) dated 19-10-2020

coal_lignite_units.vintage: installed from 2017-01-01 (incl. units with EC and under construction at notification)

note_on_cpcb_text: CPCB overview writes the 2nd vintage as "installed after 1st January 2003, up to 31st December 2016"; CEA review report uses "January 2004 to December 2016". The gazette boundary is units installed before 31-12-2003 vs after 01-01-2004.

pre_2015_norm.note: earlier Schedule I PM norm (no SO2/NOx limits; SO2 controlled only via stack height)

rules.h_m: H = 14 * Q^0.3 (Q = SO2 emission kg/hr), min 30 m

stack_height.note: Under the 11-Jul-2025 rules Category C plants are exempt from SO2 limits if they meet these stack heights (by 2029-12-31)

rules.rule: install cooling tower and achieve specific water consumption <= 3.5 m3/MWh by 2017-12-07
<= 2.5 m3/MWh and zero liquid discharge (2015 text); raised to 3.0 m3/MWh by 28-06-2018 amendment
exempted from the specific-water-consumption norms by the 28-06-2018 amendment (secondary sources; gazette number not verified)

water.condenser_cooling_discharge: temperature rise <= 10 C over intake (seawater plants); discharge not permitted in estuaries/near mangroves, coral reefs

gas_naphtha_turbines.stack_height: H = 14 * Q^0.3 (Q SO2 kg/hr), min 30 m

beneficiated_coal.rule: ash <= 34% (quarterly avg) for non-pithead plants >1000 km from pithead or in urban/ecologically sensitive/critically polluted areas (immediately), 750-1000 km (from 2015-01-01), 500-749 km (from 2016-06-05); CFBC/AFBC/PFBC/IGCC exempt

fly_ash_utilisation.rule: 100% utilisation targets; 2021 notification sets 3-year cycle compliance with environmental compensation
